pral-before-verb.title: Subject + pral + verb
pral-before-verb.bodyMarkdown:
Use this future pattern:

**Subject + pral + verb**

For example:

**Mwen pral achte manje.**

The important new marker in this topic is **pral** before the action.

demen-pral.title: Demen mwen pral achte yon machin
demen-pral.bodyMarkdown:
Here is a complete future example:

**Demen mwen pral achte yon machin.**

**Demen** supplies the tomorrow context, while **pral** appears before **achte**.

pral-familiar-action.title: Mwen pral achte manje
pral-familiar-action.bodyMarkdown:
Here is another future example:

**Mwen pral achte manje.**

Again, **pral** comes before the action **achte**.
